method: node elimination from the PI rule of this degree with nodes allowed on the boundary (GPU Levenberg-Marquardt with annealing acceptance and node kicks, float32 search, float64 polish), unsymmetric, one node then moved 1.4e-6 outside the domain along the solution manifold so that the interval proof decides that the rule has a node outside (PO); checked numerically; the weights were then minimised in the L2 norm under all moment equations with a penalty for nodes outside the domain and the symmetry kept (tools/minimize_l2.py)
author: Claude (Anthropic), commissioned and directed by Joerg Kubitz
